title: Fine Tennis Bracelet
descriptionHtml:
The everyday line of light. One continuous row of small round brilliant clear cubic zirconia, each about 2.5mm and each in its own gold claw cup, closed with a slim box clasp. Finer than our Rivière Eternal, so it slips under a cuff or stacks with a watch without crowding it.

STYLING TIP: Wear it beside a watch every day.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 17cm
  • Stones: Round brilliant clear cubic zirconia, approximately 2.5mm each
  • Setting: Each stone in its own gold claw cup, edge to edge
  • Closure: Box clasp
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
